labs.title: Square-lattice string-herald decoder
labs.summary: Concluded configuration-level study of hard herald predecoding plus syndrome-only PyMatching on square and honeycomb lattices.
labs.current_focus: Lab 001 is concluded; its frozen simulator, boundary conventions, and hard-decision baseline feed Labs 002–003.
labs.next_action: No further implementation in Lab 001. Use its observations and conventions as inputs to Lab 002 and threshold work in Lab 003.

labs.title: Herald-aware belief matching
labs.summary: The phenomenological belief-matching backend is frozen on synchronous damped Numba BP and posterior-LLR PyMatching; D4 adaptation begins through Lab 004 R6A.
labs.current_focus: Lab 002 is concluded at the corrected-LLR C8 evidence boundary; its frozen backend feeds Labs 003–005.
labs.next_action: No further Lab 002 transitions; use the frozen posterior-LLR/damped-Numba backend downstream.

labs.title: Herald decoding threshold phase diagram
labs.summary: Phase B18 presents current B14/B11 evidence with a p<->1-p symmetry-constrained guide, the full p=[0,0.5] domain, and the unchanged conservative directional region.
labs.current_focus: Lab 003 is concluded at the B18 symmetry-constrained finite-window evidence boundary.
labs.next_action: No further Lab 003 transitions; any new threshold or phase-boundary sampling requires a separately registered follow-on study.

labs.title: D4 intrinsic-heralded decoder reproduction
labs.summary: Closed under narrowed first-stage public-record D4 scope: paper herald-weight MWPM reproduction and dense finite-size LER diagnostic.
labs.current_focus: Closed; complete two-stage recovery, converged BP, and conditioned-optimal decoding are deferred.
labs.next_action: No further Lab 004 execution; deferred questions require a future lab.

labs.title: Spacetime just-in-time anyonic decoding
labs.summary: Lab 005 transfers the Lyons–Brown repeated-measurement/JIT structure to an explicitly labelled D4 projector/fusion model.
labs.current_focus: The D4 translation remains structurally active, but R6AH withdraws legacy R5a as a spatial-performance baseline; any performance input must use the remediated R6AF interface.
labs.next_action: Implement and test the registered D4 translation interface matrix; keep stochastic history generation and schedule-performance sampling blocked until it passes.

labs.title: SU(N) full-irrep belief propagation
labs.summary: Completed full-irrep belief-matching study of U(1), SU(2), and SU(3) on square/honeycomb lattices under directed and hidden pair orientation.
labs.current_focus: Concluded at the audited 600-cell paired comparison: SU2 orientation invariance, U1/SU3 practical LER sensitivity, and bounded finite-size interpretation.
labs.next_action: No further Lab 006 acquisition. Lab 007 owns statistical mechanics, conjugacy, the hard-decoder gap, and the KT/BKT-like hypothesis.

labs.title: Statistical mechanics of representation-informed decoding
labs.summary: Exact statistical-mechanics formulation of representation-informed decoding: sector posteriors, SU(2) orientation quotient, constrained currents and fusion vertex models, with finite hardening counterexamples.
labs.current_focus: Completed exact classical formulation: normalized sector weights, SU(2) orientation quotient, spin/current and restricted loop reductions, and verified finite decoder-hardening counterexamples.
labs.next_action: Next scientific direction: controlled typical-record sector contraction on finite-width strips, compared with exact-marginal and BP-marginal matching; continuum universality remains open.
